faqs.a: If your HVAC system is 15 years old or older, replacement is usually the better option, and systems over 10 years old require more effort to maintain comfort, resulting in higher energy bills. If your furnace is newer and still performing well, a repair may be the most cost-effective choice - a professional inspection from Hero Air's experts can help determine the best path forward.
faqs.q: How do I know whether to repair or replace my system?

faqs.a: Regular HVAC maintenance prevents costly repairs and extends the life of your system. It also keeps your system running at its best, which can lower energy costs, and many manufacturers require routine maintenance to maintain warranty coverage. Maintenance also enhances indoor air quality by reducing the accumulation of dust and debris in your home.

Check your air filter every month and replace it when it becomes dirty - in most homes, filters should be changed every one to three months, depending on dust levels and usage. A clogged filter restricts airflow, increases energy costs, and reduces indoor air quality.
faqs.q: How often should I change my air filter?
